name: PirateBay Ad Blocker
description: Blocks annoying popups, fake download buttons, and malicious ads on pirate sites like 1337x and Pirate Bay variants.
author: Munya Mpofu

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; media-src 'none'; child-src 'none'; connect-src https:; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; object-src 'none'
